# The Next-Generation Evolution of Quake in Minecraft

Quakechasm is a feature-rich Quake minigame plugin for Minecraft servers running Paper. It faithfully recreates the classic arena FPS gameplay of Quake 3 Arena and Quake Live, bringing authentic Quake mechanics and excitement into Minecraft.

## Why Use Quakechasm?

Quakechasm delivers a true Quake experience in Minecraft with deep mechanics and classic gameplay that go beyond typical instagib-style minigames. It is perfect for Minecraft communities seeking fast-paced, skill-based arena combat with familiar Quake elements.

## Features
- 7 iconic Quake weapons like Rocket Launcher, Railgun, and BFG
- 3 powerups including the classic Quad Damage
- Health and armor pickups modeled on Quake 3
- Mobility mechanics such as Slipgate teleporters, jumppads, and rocketjumping
- 3 game modes: Free For All, Team Deathmatch, and Capture the Flag
- Custom HUD with weapon info, ammo counters, and powerup timers
- Visual particles, customizable sounds, and custom death messages
- Multi-team spawn systems and experimental bunnyhopping/strafejumping

## Important information
- A custom resource pack is required for this plugin to function! Please see [Github repo](https://github.com/polyzium/quakechasm) for more details.
- This plugin will only run on Paper (and forks) 1.21.8 or above and Java 21 or above. Spigot is NOT supported.
- Requires WorldEdit for map management and CommandAPI for commands. The plugin will not function without these depedencies.
